title: qa-onboard-quiz quiz.json: the blind exam of a codebase map
description: Written by qa-onboard-quiz (scripts/grade_quiz.py) to <evid_root>/onboard/<project>/quiz/round-<n>/quiz.json. The onboarding loop's evaluator. Three blind agents take part and none sees another's inputs: a question writer reads the CODE (never the map) and writes questions with answer keys cited to file and line; an examiner reads the MAP (never the code) and answers; a judge reads the key and the answer and grades them. The grader script then checks every cite against the real files, so a key that points at nothing is thrown out and an answer that cites code no map claim cites is caught as an examiner that peeked. The router branches on `status` and reads `questions[].failure_class` to pick the next move per area. See docs/onboarding-loop.md.

commit.description: The map's commit. The questions were written against this tree.

status.description: The one branch field. pass = score >= threshold, no area below area_floor, and the question set was trustworthy. fail = a real negative: the map could not answer enough. blocked = could not tell (no scored questions, a missing judge grade, too many bad keys, or an examiner that was not blind). Only fail routes to relearning; blocked retries the quiz or escalates.

blocked_reason.description: Set only when status is blocked.

score.description: Mean question score over scored questions: correct 1, partial 0.5, everything else 0. Discarded questions are not scored.

area_floor.description: No area with at least two scored questions may score below this, so a strong area cannot hide a blind one.

by_area.description: area id -> {scored, score, below_floor}. The router relearns areas, not questions.

failure_class.description: Why this question was lost, which decides what changes next. missing = the map has nothing on it. wrong = the map says something the code contradicts. vague = right neighbourhood, no precise cite. stale = the code it rests on changed since the map's commit. why-gap = a why question the record was never mined for. bad-key = the writer's key cites nothing real, so the question is discarded. outside-map = the answer cites code no named map claim cites.

from_claims.description: The map claims the examiner answered from. A wrong answer points the router at these claims.

judged_blind.description: True only when writer, examiner and judge were separate fresh-context agents. A quiz graded by the agent that wrote the map is not a quiz.
